app.notes:
Real-time + jam WIB + dukungan mouse & keyboard!

- Candle terakhir bergerak real-time mengikuti harga live
- Jam WIB (Asia/Jakarta) di header
- Kotak pencarian pair (ketik mis. BTC / EUR / XAU)
- Mouse: scroll = zoom chart, geser+tahan = pan, hover = crosshair
- Keyboard: 1-6 timeframe, +/- zoom, M overlay, V sub-panel, P pair, U update, S cari, Esc kembali
- Perbaikan: error 'unable to resolve' (DNS) jauh lebih jarang (keep-alive + retry + failover host)
- Fallback emas: XAU/USD otomatis pakai Binance XAUT bila Yahoo bermasalah
